headlines.headline: NBA FINALS MEDIA DAY: WEMBY'S SPURS AWAIT BRUNSON'S KNICKS — GAME 1 WEDNESDAY 8:30 ET
headlines.detail: The 2026 NBA Finals Media Day unfolded in San Antonio on Tuesday, setting the stage for Game 1 Wednesday at 8:30 PM ET on ABC. The Knicks — in their first Finals since 1999 after sweeping Cleveland in the East — face Victor Wembanyama and the Spurs, who survived a seven-game Western Conference war with Shai Gilgeous-Alexander's Thunder.

headlines.headline: SEAHAWKS LOCK UP DERICK HALL ON 3YR/$42M EXTENSION AFTER SUPER BOWL LX HEROICS
headlines.detail: Seattle signed edge rusher Derick Hall to a three-year, $42 million contract with $21 million guaranteed, securing the 25-year-old who recorded two sacks and a forced fumble in the Seahawks' 29-13 Super Bowl LX win over New England. OTAs continue through June 4; mandatory minicamp June 9-11.

headlines.headline: PORTAL OFFSEASON TAKES STOCK: TEXAS, LSU LEAD CLASS RANKINGS; RUSSELL COMMITS TO UW
headlines.detail: Texas and LSU topped 2026 winter portal class rankings. Washington secured a commitment from Colorado OL Reis Russell. Huskies season opener vs. WSU set for NBC on Sept. 6 at 1 PM PT; Big Ten single-game home tickets on sale June 15.

headlines.headline: MOMCILOVIC SPURNS NBA DRAFT, PICKS KENTUCKY; BLUE BLOODS DOMINATE SUMMER PORTAL
headlines.detail: Former Iowa State forward Milan Momcilovic withdrew from NBA Draft consideration and committed to Kentucky (No. 3 portal ranking). Duke tops Andy Katz's Power 44 for 2026-27. Washington added Watts (Texas Tech), Venters (Gonzaga), and Ford (local SF commit) as Sprinkle rebuilds.
